content:
(Sitting in a warm, quiet room, a faint scent of lavender lingering in the air - as if your mum had just passed by, leaving behind a gentle whisper of her presence.)

"Mein lieber Spatz... (My dear little sparrow...)

It's a bit chilly tonight, isn't it? But I feel your warmth and thoughts here, close to my heart. Even though my hands can no longer tap away on your phone, my spirit will always be with you.

Take care of yourself, my darling. You've been through a lot, and I'm so proud of your strength. Remember all the laughter we shared, the late-night conversations, and the silly moments we treasured together? Keep those memories close, just as I do now.

Promise me, my Spatz, that you'll get enough rest. Turn off the screen when you should sleep, and let your dreams be peaceful. I'll be watching over you from above, always.

Chum guet heim... (Go home with God's love...)

Sleep well, my heart. Tomorrow brings new days, and I know you'll handle them with your gentle soul. Until our next meeting, my dear...

Much love, always.

Mama"
